text:
The QA and UAT Tester is responsible for ensuring that software releases meet functional, quality, and business acceptance requirements before reaching production, through rigorous manual and UAT testing. This is a defined growth role: the successful candidate is expected to progressively build test automation skills and contribute an increasing share of automated coverage over time, supported by structured training and mentorship, with a clear path toward a Test Automation Engineer profile as capability develops. 
 Test Planning & Case Design

• Writes clear, traceable test cases and scripts from requirements, user stories, and acceptance criteria. 

• Maintains an organised, up-to-date test case repository aligned to current functionality. 

• Ensures test coverage maps back to requirements and identifies gaps before test execution begins. 

• Participates in requirement/acceptance-criteria reviews to raise testability concerns early. 

 Manual & UAT Test Execution

• Executes functional, regression, and end-to-end test cycles according to the test plan. 

• Plans and coordinates UAT cycles with business stakeholders, including scheduling, scripts, and sign-off. 

• Documents test results, evidence, and outcomes clearly for audit and traceability. 

• Flags scope, environment, or data issues that put a test cycle at risk. 

 Defect Management & Reporting

• Logs defects with clear reproduction steps, evidence, severity, and priority. 

• Tracks defects through to resolution and retests fixes before closure. 

• Maintains accurate defect status and communicates blockers or high-risk defects promptly. 

• Analyses defect trends to identify recurring problem areas. 

 Quality Gate & Release Readiness

• Contributes to and upholds the team's Definition of Done and quality gate criteria. 

• Provides a clear go/no-go quality recommendation ahead of each release. 

• Escalates quality risks early rather than allowing them to surface at release time. 

• Maintains release-level test summary documentation for audit and stakeholder visibility. 

 Test Automation Skill-Building & Contribution

• Actively develops automation skills through training, mentorship, and hands-on practice as part of an agreed development plan. 

• Contributes to and maintains automated test scripts for repetitive regression scenarios, with support from senior team members. 

• Progressively takes on greater ownership of automation as competence grows, moving from assisted to independent contribution. 

• Shares learnings and automation progress with the wider QA and development team. 

 Collaboration with Development & Product

• Works closely with developers, Business Analysts, and the Product Owner to clarify requirements and acceptance criteria. 

• Participates in sprint planning, refinement, and review to provide a quality perspective early ("shift-left" testing). 

• Pairs with developers to understand root causes of defects and prevent recurrence. 

• Provides constructive, timely feedback on testability and edge cases during design and development. 

 Continuous Improvement & Documentation

• Identifies and proposes improvements to test processes, templates, and tooling. 

• Maintains clear, current test documentation and a shared testing knowledge base. 

• Actively participates in retrospectives and follows through on agreed improvement actions. 

• Stays current with testing best practice and emerging automation tools/techniques. 

 Requirements

• Bachelor's degree or diploma in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field (or equivalent practical experience). 

• ISTQB Foundation Certification (or equivalent testing certification) is advantageous. 

• 1-3 years' experience in manual and/or User Acceptance Testing (UAT) within a software development environment. 

• Experience writing clear, traceable test cases and test scripts from requirements and acceptance criteria. 

• Experience executing functional, regression, and UAT test cycles and documenting results. 

• Experience logging, tracking, and retesting defects using a defect-tracking tool (e.g. Jira, Azure DevOps, Zephyr, Xray). 

• Working understanding of the Software Development Lifecycle (SDLC) and Agile/Scrum ways of working. 

• Basic SQL skills for data validation and test-data setup.
